6-Speed Automatic Transmission and 2WD The 6-speed automatic transmission pairs smoothly with the V8, keeping highway cruising comfortable and improving fuel efficiency compared to the older 4-speed units. Boasting a powerful Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine, this truck delivers unparalleled capability and performance. Outfitted with a comprehensive suite of premium features, this Silverado is the epitome of rugged sophistication.

— Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package

— Up-Level Rear Seat w/Storage Package

Indulge in the convenience of the Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System, the comfort of heated and ventilated front seats, and the peace of mind provided by the Adaptive Cruise Control and HD Surround Vision. This Silverado also offers a wealth of connectivity features, including SiriusXM with 360L, Bluetooth, and Wireless Charging, ensuring you stay seamlessly connected on the go.

Designed to tackle the toughest jobs, the 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LTZ boasts a Chevytec Spray-On Black Bedliner, a Power Tailgate, and a Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package, making it the ultimate workhorse. The rugged exterior is complemented by the luxurious interior, featuring leather-appointed seating, a power sunroof, and a heated steering wheel for unparalleled comfort.

Safety is paramount in this Silverado, with features like Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert, and Ultrasonic Front & Rear Park Assist ensuring you and your cargo arrive at your destination with confidence. The In-Vehicle Trailering App System and Hitch Guidance with Hitch View further simplify the towing experience, making this Silverado an exceptional choice for those with demanding hauling needs.

Whether you're tackling a job site, navigating the open road, or embarking on a weekend adventure, this 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LTZ is the perfect companion. Experience the perfect blend of power, technology, and luxury by scheduling a test drive today.

Cylinder deactivation technology improves fuel efficiency without sacrificing power, making this SUV as efficient as it is powerful.
